title: fix: fail fast on tool calls stuck after a dead browser connection

target.summary: Racing the entire tool execution against a 60-second watchdog timer and calling forgetBrowserOnTimeout aborts legitimate long operations (such as wait_for with a long timeout, slow scripts, or audits) and closes healthy browsers.
notes: faulty statement racing tool execution against timeout and calling forgetBrowserOnTimeout
call site passing the forget browser callback to ToolHandler
definition of the helper the call relies on to tear down the browser on timeout
